findings: ProductHero adds exactly three calls: timerAdded after original RunLoop timer registration, first tick with the existing now, and first applied with the existing now/p after original view.progress assignment. Timer setup, original guards, spring calculations, frame/corner/progress/needsDisplay, phase band and deadlines are preserved.

Observer state is three native slots, at most two live rows and one transient pending callback. callbackEntered uses the existing callback counter; nonlive callbacks only replace pending. keepLive runs after the original scalar/sample record and single-flight identity guards. After two live rows, prefix/matching hooks return before taking another new clock; native first slots also stop updating.

WindowInfo begin/end brackets the existing whole fixtureWindowInfo call; scalars begin/end brackets the existing whole fixtureScalars call. matchingBegin is inside the existing weak-wrapper matching observer. No extra UI/window/view/layer/provider query, image/object holder, formatting, timer, run-loop action, progress readback or presentation flush is added by the timing enum.

The two live rows carry actual callback_id/sample_index, existing scalar state uptime, identity, started and progress values. Adjacent callback/sample and pinned-flight conditions are checked at finish. These fields describe those recorded callbacks, not rendered frames.

The second row intentionally copies the first mapping observation timestamp. It is not the second matching end. first_applied.now is reused tick-entry now, not a fresh timestamp at assignment completion. Timer-added time follows registration; WindowInfo/scalars brackets include their existing internal work and do not isolate a single query or weak comparison.

Trace freezes before original cleanup/teardown and is serialized after teardown. Missing slots/rows or invalid ordering remain incomplete, preserving partial live/pending records. complete describes trace coverage only; success additionally requires original acquisition. Failed acquisition or trace finalization propagates to nonzero without manufactured rows or original acceptance.

The only new mode guard narrows this diagnostic to default13/default14; original native/execution/cache/normal/front/3PNG and sampling limits are retained. The SDR snapshot/conversion logic and original application loop are preserved.
limits: No build/typecheck/runtime acceptance is claimed. Future native review must execute unchanged full original and appended gates, distinguishing strict success from partial acquisition.

Trace timestamps do not prove visual timing, sampling/pixel synchrony or presentation order. First tick can precede first application when original guards skip work.
